# Native MCP fixtures

These handwritten fixtures use the documented common configuration forms checked
on 2026-09-07. They are inputs and independently expected outputs; the transfer
renderer does not generate them. No credential values or live servers are used.

- Claude: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp
- Codex: https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference/
- Cursor: https://prod.cursor.com/docs/mcp
- Gemini: https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/mcp-server/
- OpenCode classic: https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers/

Schema agreement is separate from native client discovery, approval or login.
